_purpose: Corrected re-measurement of validation/manifests/3d_breakthrough_baseline.json (see that file's copy at 3d_breakthrough_baseline_v1_confounded.json), run through Mol.conformer_ensemble() AFTER fixing issue #172 (atom-index desync between returned coordinates and the caller's own Mol topology) in commit 9face7e5c7 (https://github.com/kent-tokyo/chematic/pull/180). Same script (scripts/etkdg_vs_rdkit_gap.py), same 58-molecule corpus, same methodology (5 independent fresh Python process runs) as v1 -- only the underlying conformer_ensemble() implementation differs. See atom_index_bug_reconciliation below for the re-derived 21/22 artifact/genuine split.

meta.methodology_note: Identical methodology to v1: 5 independent fresh Python process invocations of scripts/etkdg_vs_rdkit_gap.py (not loop iterations), built/run against an isolated venv (.venv-fix in the fix's own worktree, never the shared .venv) with the fixed conformer_ensemble(). Raw per-run summaries at validation/results/etkdg_baseline_history/run{1..5}_summary_v2_atom_order_corrected.json and run{1..5}_rows_v2_atom_order_corrected.jsonl.

raw_embed_returned_rate.note: fraction where the embedder returned finite, non-clashing coordinates at all -- does NOT check geometric validity (bond lengths etc). See geometrically_valid_rate for that.

geometrically_valid_rate.note: fraction of the whole corpus that produced a geometry passing the >50%-of-covalent-reference bond-length check (status == 'ok'). This is the metric that should be called 'success' -- raw_embed_returned_rate alone is misleadingly high because chematic's coordinate generator never refuses to return coordinates, it just sometimes returns a torn structure.

fair_mmff94_energy_delta_chematic_minus_.note: positive = chematic's own conformer scores WORSE than RDKit's geometry under chematic's own full MMFF94 breakdown (same topology, same energy function -- an apples-to-apples geometry-quality signal, not an absolute energy comparison).

chirality_all_geometry.note: Rolled up over EVERY declared stereocenter reached, including torn (chematic_bond_length_blowup) geometry. A signed-volume or dihedral-sign read on a torn molecule conflates 'no stereo enforcement' with 'garbage geometry' -- use chirality_clean_geometry for the unconfounded match-rate signal; this block is provided for coverage (which is a structural fact independent of geometry quality) and for transparency, not for the match-rate column.

chirality_clean_geometry.note: Same rollup restricted to status=='ok' rows only (no bond >50% off the covalent-radius reference). Small n by construction -- Phase 0's blow-up bug (see docs/etkdg_3d_gap_rfc.md) removed most of the tetrahedral-4-heavy and alkene rows from this subset -- but this is the only match-rate signal not confounded by torn geometry.

deterministic_metrics_frozen._note: Every field below was byte-identical across all 5 independent process runs (single-conformer path, noise_sigma_deg=0.0), both at the aggregate level and the individual per-molecule row-status level -- safe to freeze, matching v1's own methodology exactly (validation/manifests/3d_breakthrough_baseline.json, meta.n_independent_process_runs=5).

runtime_metrics_non_frozen._note: Wall-clock timing varies run-to-run (machine noise, same shape as issue #70) -- recorded as mean/stdev/min/max across the 5 runs, NOT a single frozen value, matching v1's own methodology.

ensemble_metrics_observed_not_contracted._note: Same observation as v1: chematic-3d's PRNG self-seeds from a process-global atomic counter with no public seed parameter; empirically bit-identical across all 5 independent v2 process runs here too (identical=True), recorded as an OBSERVATION not a contracted guarantee, same caveat as v1.

atom_index_bug_reconciliation._purpose: Independent re-derivation of PR #167 (Agent C, distance_geometry_v2)'s claim that the v1 baseline's 43 non-'ok' rows split into 21 pure index-mismatch artifacts + 22 genuine defects. PR #167 measured this via its own separate Rust scratch probe (own bond-length reference table, never through conformer_ensemble() at all). This reconciliation instead re-runs the SAME harness (scripts/etkdg_vs_rdkit_gap.py) that produced v1, unchanged, only through the fixed conformer_ensemble() (commit 9face7e5c7), and compares v1 vs v2 status by molecule NAME, not by count alone.
atom_index_bug_reconciliation.result: CONFIRMED: 21 artifact_only / 22 genuine / 0 new_in_v2 -- matches PR #167's claimed 21/22/0 exactly, independently re-derived (not assumed).
atom_index_bug_reconciliation.status_mode_changes_note: Molecules here remain non-'ok' under both v1 and v2 (counted as 'genuine' either way), but the SPECIFIC failure classification changed -- e.g. l_threonine went from chematic_bond_length_blowup (v1) to chematic_gross_clash (v2): consistent indexing changed which check trips first, not whether the molecule is defect-free.

known_dead_or_unwired_code_confirmed_pre.dg_fft.rs: Present, ~840 lines, #![allow(dead_code)], zero callers workspace-wide (confirmed: grep -rn 'generate_coords_dg\b' returns only its own definition/tests). This is Agent C's primary starting point per the RFC.
known_dead_or_unwired_code_confirmed_pre.stereo3d.rs: Present, 471 lines, NOT dead -- assign_stereo_from_3d is exported from lib.rs and used by this very gap script (cm.stereo_from_coords) to perceive stereo FROM a 3D geometry. This is the opposite direction from what Agent D needs (enforcing DECLARED stereo AS a constraint during embedding) -- Agent D should not assume this file already solves its problem.
known_dead_or_unwired_code_confirmed_pre.chematic-ff full MMFF94/UFF: Present and complete (bond/angle/oop_stbn/torsion/vdw + L-BFGS), confirmed NOT called by chematic-3d/src/minimize.rs, which hand-rolls a smaller bond+angle+VdW-only energy function. Agent F's primary target.
